_comment: Port Houston Container Service Schedule, Revised January 2026 (source PDF uploaded 2026-02). 19 liner services. 'rotation' lists cleaned port keys (see ports.json). 'raw' preserves the PDF text verbatim. 'notes' records every cleanup/interpretation. AAOPT (a Port Houston terminal/berth code, not a foreign port) and 'Escobedo' (no known seaport) are omitted from drawn rotations and flagged.

services.name: INDUSA
services.raw: Houston USA, Freeport Grand Bahamas, Savannah, Veracruz, Cristobal, Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, Jebel, Ali, Mundra, Jawaharlal Nehru, Colombo, Trivandrum.
services.notes: Deduped 'Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi'; joined 'Jebel, Ali' -> Jebel Ali; Trivandrum -> Vizhinjam.

services.name: MAERSK MECL

services.notes: Omitted 'AAOPT' (Houston terminal code, appears mid-rotation). 'Qasim Terminal/Karachi' and 'Muhammad Bin Qasim' both = Port Qasim (two calls). Munda -> Mundra.

services.notes: PDF prints the loop TWICE; collapsed to one cycle re-anchored at Houston. Barcelona is called TWICE per cycle (after Las Palmas, and again after Genoa) - both kept. 'Freeport Grand Bal' -> Freeport, Grand Bahama. Trailing 'San Salvador' omitted as a doubled-text artifact.
